Flagship history: '''Decipher World Championships 1996–2001'''. Each year has a hub (location, field, top cut, narrative, sourced decklists). Lists come from public pages after an archive.org / archive.today snapshot.

The 1999 event was at DecipherCon in Virginia Beach. The 2000 event was at [[DecipherCon 2000]] in Kissimmee, Florida, with surviving official photographs and the Final Confrontation video on that page.

Players Committee Worlds from 2002 on are indexed on [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]. Year hubs on this wiki currently include [[2014 World Championship]] through [[2026 World Championship]] (gaps remain for some 2002–2013 years).
